messages:
Maya: Opening a docs PR in ~15m to rewrite the embed-sharding section across nebula3b, aurora-lite3b, and vega13b model cards. Goal: explicit heuristics, update SDK v4 snippets, and add dedicated vs hosted note on prefix caching.
Jin: Thanks — which exact cards and what kinds of changes?
Maya: Mainly embed sharding math, recommended shard sizes for high-dim embeddings, and a migration blurb for SDK rename shard_count -> partition_count.
Samir: Are we changing defaults or just guidance?
Maya: Guidance only. New heuristic: aim for per-shard vector counts below ~10k to avoid OOMs during batched cosine matmuls; I'll cite bench CSV.
Louise: Heads up SDK v4 uses partition_count and client.embed_batch instead of client.embed. I'll update code samples and module docs.
Maya: Example I'll add:
```python
# SDK v3
client.embed("images", vectors, shard_count=4)
# SDK v4
client.embed_batch("images", vectors, partition_count=4)
```
Samir: Ran quick bench on nebula3b@q8: 12k vectors peaked ~6.2GB with batch 128. I'll attach raw CSV to PR and flag param sweep.
Maya: Also adding a note: Dedicated autoscaling can cause effective shard parallelism to drop under high load — mention for users relying on shard count.
docs-bot: PR opened by Maya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4822 — "embed sharding: heuristics + sdk migration"
Jin: Quick review checklist: 1) numeric examples match bench, 2) link to bench CSV, 3) no promises about exact lat improvements.
Louise: Minor nit: switch to client.embed_batch in snippets. I'll push that change.
Maya: Can someone sanity-check wording: "Prefer shard sizes that fit GPU memory; large shards hurt throughput due to bigger matmuls and tokenization overhead." Suggest edits.
Jin: Shorten: "Prefer shard sizes that fit GPU memory; very large shards reduce throughput because matmul and tokenization costs grow."
Maya: Updated PR description.
Samir: Added CSV and bench notes to PR comments.
Louise: I'll add a one-line compatibility note: Hosted auto-fallback to single-shard when per-request memory exceeds limit.
Maya: Thanks — will merge after Louise's snippet update and one more doc review. :thumbsup:
Louise: Pushing commit now.
Maya: Merging once CI passes.
